node: Electricity demand growth from AI/data centers and electrification
summary: Direct exposure to this node is concentrated in visible large caps, but the more interesting Layer 1B expansion is the physical electrical infrastructure stack: transmission hardware, grid equipment, power quality, transformers, and nuclear fuel/advanced fuel components. The strongest underfollowed lane here is not hyperscalers or utilities themselves, but niche suppliers one or two steps upstream of grid capex and data-center power buildouts. Evidence is strongest for a few public names with narrow product exposure; several additional candidates remain hypotheses requiring verification of revenue mix and customer concentration.
